description: This file defines the 'Event' class within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Setting' namespace. The class provides methods to manage event records in the database, including adding, deleting, updating, and retrieving events. It extends the base Model class of the system engine.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Model class for managing system events in the admin setting context.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Inserts a new event record into the database with provided data and returns the inserted record's ID.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event record from the database based on its event ID.

methods.name: deleteEventByCode
methods.description: Deletes an event record from the database based on its unique code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status (enabled/disabled) of an event identified by its event ID.

methods.name: editStatusByCode
methods.description: Updates the status of an event identified by its unique code.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves details of an event by its ID.

methods.name: getEventByCode
methods.description: Retrieves details of an event by its code.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of events, optionally sorted, ordered, and paginated based on provided parameters.

methods.name: getTotalEvents
methods.description: Returns the total count of events in the database.
